tasks.title: Repo hygiene and CI
tasks.detail: Add docs/prompt/ and data/ to ignore rules, remove prototype leftovers listed in CLEANUP.md, add .github/workflows/ci.yml running backend tests, frontend typecheck/build and a secret scan.
tasks.acceptance: CI workflow runs on push, backend suite green, no prototype TODO markers left in tracked files.
tasks.note: CI extended (secret scan, hygiene, feat branches), ignore rules, CLEANUP.md inventory

tasks.title: Branch and release policy
tasks.detail: Document main/develop/feat flow in CONTRIBUTING.md, add CHANGELOG.md with an Unreleased section, add a release script that tags from develop.
tasks.acceptance: CONTRIBUTING.md describes the flow, CHANGELOG exists, release script tested in dry-run.

tasks.title: Configuration from environment
tasks.detail: Remove remaining hardcoded absolute paths from backend modules, read them from environment with documented defaults, fail fast with a clear message when required values are missing.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover missing and invalid configuration, no absolute developer path remains in backend/.

tasks.title: Health and readiness split
tasks.detail: /healthz stays liveness, add /readyz that checks PostgreSQL, vault and plugin directory, with a structured body.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover each dependency failing and the aggregate result.

tasks.title: User store and password policy
tasks.detail: Add users table with argon2 hashes, roles admin/operator/viewer, creation and rotation of the bootstrap admin, password strength validation.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover hashing, role checks, weak password refusal, duplicate user refusal.

tasks.title: Session security
tasks.detail: Replace the ad-hoc session with httpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies, absolute and idle timeouts, CSRF token bound to the session, logout invalidation, rate limited login.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover cookie flags, expiry, CSRF mismatch, brute-force throttling.

tasks.title: API tokens for agents
tasks.detail: Scope-limited tokens with expiry, rotation and revocation, audit entry per use, read-only scope still enforced for infrastructure reads.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover expiry, revocation, scope denial and audit records.

tasks.title: OIDC-ready authentication
tasks.detail: Add a provider abstraction so an external identity provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Entra) can be configured without touching the login path; disabled by default.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover disabled provider, discovery failure, and successful claim mapping with a stub.

tasks.title: Black and light theme
tasks.detail: CSS variables for both themes, persisted preference, no flash of wrong theme, no remote fonts.
tasks.acceptance: Frontend tests cover preference persistence and default; build passes.

tasks.title: Navigation and empty states
tasks.detail: Restructure navigation, remove prototype wording from every page, add empty states and loading states.
tasks.acceptance: Snapshot-level tests for the page registry, no French or prototype wording in tracked UI strings.

tasks.title: External dashboard registry
tasks.detail: Model external observability tools (Grafana, Uptime Kuma, Prometheus, Netdata) as integrations with URL, kind, health probe and optional embed flag; no built-in dashboard code.
tasks.acceptance: Schema validated, CRUD tested, refusal for non-http URLs and for embed without allowlist.

tasks.title: Dashboard embedding policy
tasks.detail: Serve an embed page that only frames allowlisted origins, with CSP frame-src derived from the registry, falling back to a deep link when embedding is not allowed.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover CSP header content and the fallback link.

tasks.title: Integration health and drift
tasks.detail: Periodic read-only probe of each integration, stored result, surfaced as a status column, never auto-remediated.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover healthy, unreachable and malformed responses.

tasks.title: Durable environment state
tasks.detail: Add state per environment and stack, encrypted at rest, with generation and resource list, replacing per-job state as the source of truth.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover concurrent apply refusal, generation increment, and state surviving restart.

tasks.title: Import existing resources
tasks.detail: Adopt an existing VM into state by UUID and ownership marker without recreating it.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover adoption, refusal when the marker mismatches, and idempotent re-import.

tasks.title: Destroy with ownership proof
tasks.detail: Destroy action with annotation and UUID proof, quarantine window, cancellation, and rollback_failed semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover refusal on foreign VM, quarantine cancel, and failed destroy state.

tasks.title: Drift report
tasks.detail: Nightly read-only comparison of declared versus live resources, producing a diff report with no remediation.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover drift detection per field and the absence of any write call.

tasks.title: Git-backed declarations
tasks.detail: Load a stack declaration from a repository path with revision pinning, and execute the CI-produced plan artifact as-is.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover digest mismatch refusal and pinned-revision execution.

tasks.title: Workload bricks in the portal
tasks.detail: Wire the workload executor into job preparation so a workload node can be planned, approved and executed from the UI, with evidence visible.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover the full path with a stub playbook and refusal for unpinned roles.

tasks.title: Zabbix preset
tasks.detail: Compose the PostgreSQL, Zabbix server, web and agent bricks as a preset graph on one VM.
tasks.acceptance: Preset validates, plan ordering respects dependencies, no new code path.

tasks.title: Backup and restore
tasks.detail: Nightly PostgreSQL dump plus vault copy, restore procedure documented and exercised against a scratch database.
tasks.acceptance: Restore test proves data equality on a scratch instance.

tasks.title: Observability
tasks.detail: Structured logs, request ids, basic metrics endpoint, and error budget documentation.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover log shape and metrics exposure.
